definition: GPT-5.2 is a large language model by OpenAI, released on December 11, 2025.
details: Succeeding GPT-5.1, it is a family of three large language models within the GPT series. It comes in three modes: GPT-5.2 instant, GPT-5.2 thinking (with standard and extended thinking), and GPT-5.2 Pro, with the latter two being reasoning models. GPT-5.2 Pro takes more reasoning time and compute than GPT-5.2 thinking. OpenAI also released a variant specialized for coding, GPT-5.2-Codex. The successor, GPT-5.3-Codex, was released on February 5, 2026, and in the following month, GPT-5.4 was released to public on March 5, 2026.

explainer.lead: GPT-5.2 is OpenAI’s family of three large language models, released on December 11, 2025. It offers different amounts of reasoning and computing effort, plus a separate variant for coding, so users can choose between a quicker general mode and more deliberative problem-solving.

tiers.eli5: GPT-5.2 is like a toolbox with helpers that think for different amounts of time. Instant handles ordinary requests, Thinking can spend longer working through a problem, and Pro uses the most time and computer effort. There is also a special helper for writing computer code.
tiers.practitioner: Choose GPT-5.2 Instant for the general mode, GPT-5.2 Thinking when you want standard or extended reasoning, and GPT-5.2 Pro when additional reasoning time and compute are acceptable. Use GPT-5.2-Codex for coding work. The main pitfall is treating Pro as a free upgrade: it deliberately costs more reasoning time and compute than Thinking.
tiers.paperLevel: GPT-5.2 = {Instant, Thinking, Pro}, where Thinking and Pro are reasoning models and Thinking supports standard and extended modes. Pro uses more reasoning time and compute than Thinking, while GPT-5.2-Codex is a coding-specialized variant. The family was released by OpenAI on December 11, 2025, after GPT-5.1.

explainer.example: A developer debugging a program could send the code to GPT-5.2-Codex. For a separate difficult problem outside coding, they could try Thinking with extended thinking, or use Pro if they are willing to spend additional reasoning time and compute.

components.name: GPT-5.2 Instant: the family’s general mode.
GPT-5.2 Thinking: a reasoning model with standard and extended thinking.
GPT-5.2 Pro: a reasoning model that uses more time and compute than Thinking.
GPT-5.2-Codex: a separate variant specialized for coding.

flow: Start with a general language task or a coding task.
For other tasks, choose Instant or one of the two reasoning models.
With Thinking, choose standard or extended thinking.
Choose Pro when the task warrants more reasoning time and compute than Thinking.
explainer.origin: OpenAI released GPT-5.2 on December 11, 2025. It succeeded GPT-5.1 as a three-model family in the GPT series.
explainer.lineage: GPT-5.2 followed GPT-5.1. GPT-5.3-Codex was released on February 5, 2026, followed by the public release of GPT-5.4 on March 5, 2026.
explainer.whyItMatters: The family makes reasoning effort an explicit choice rather than treating every request identically. Its coding variant also separates software work from the three general modes.
